messages:
Ava Lin: FYI - I noticed the /v1/generate OpenAPI still documents `timeout` as a string and examples use `generation` singular. Runtime expects `timeout_ms` (integer) and returns `generations` array. Can someone update the spec and examples?

Ravi Desai: thanks, good catch. which file path is it?

Ava Lin: openapi/specs/generate.yaml around params section + docs/examples/generate_examples.md. Quick repro: curl 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?timeout=5000' -> 400 invalid type for timeout. Server expects timeout_ms as int or X-Timeout-Ms header.

Kim Ortega: confirmed on staging. We changed to timeout_ms to be explicit and removed string coercion. I'll open a docs PR to: update OpenAPI param to integer `timeout_ms`, switch example responses to use `generations` array, add a short migration note, and update curl/python/js snippets (note JS uses `timeoutMs`).

Ravi Desai: please include the exact YAML and JSON examples in the PR so reviewers can copy-paste. Also add a one-liner test in infra/integration that asserts `generations` key exists in responses.

Kim Ortega: YAML for param to use in PR:
```yaml
parameters:
  - name: timeout_ms
    in: query
    schema:
      type: integer
      format: int32
      example: 5000
```
JSON response sample to add/update in docs:
```json
{
  "id": "req_123",
  "model": "rwd-13b",
  "generations": [
    {"text": "hello", "tokens": ["hello"], "metadata": {}}
  ],
  "perf": {"latency_ms": 45}
}
```

Ava Lin: small note for SDK docs: map HTTP `timeout_ms` to JS `timeoutMs` (camelCase).

build-bot: PR created by Kim Ortega: https://git.redwood/infer/docs/pull/4601 (labels: docs, breaking-change, needs-review)

Ravi Desai: assigning reviewers @Ava Lin @Kim Ortega. I'll add the infra smoke test change in a separate PR after this lands.

Kim Ortega: thanks — will add changelog entry and migration doc at docs/migrations/generate-timeout-ms-response-array.md. Aiming to merge after 2 approvals and green CI. :thumbsup:
